intuition: Represent the text on either side of the cursor separately so cursor moves transfer only the characters requested.

brute_force.approach: Keep one string and rebuild slices around the cursor for every insertion, deletion, and move.
brute_force.time: addText O(n), deleteText O(n), cursorLeft O(n), cursorRight O(n)

optimal.approach: Use stacks for text before and after the cursor; move characters between stacks and read only the last ten on the left.
optimal.time: addText O(k), deleteText O(k), cursorLeft O(k), cursorRight O(k)

edge_cases: The cursor cannot move beyond either end of the text.
Delete and cursor methods process fewer than k characters when the side is shorter.
